simple one to one so you won uh you won on average let's say $100 and you lost on average let's say $100 so now to calculate the criterion so how much we should risk we simply plug in the numbers so the amount we need to risk is simply 60% or in other words 0.60 minus remember our loss rate which is 0.4 or in other words uh 40% and divided by your risk-to-reward and remember here we have divided
